entities.summary: Josep Oms Pallise is a Spanish chess player who holds the title of Grandmaster (GM) (2007) and from 2003 till 2007 played for Andorra. He is four-times Andorran Chess Championship winner (2003–2006) and Chess Olympiad individual gold medal winner (2006).

entities.summary: Josep Oms Pallise is a Spanish chess player who holds the title of Grandmaster (GM) (2007) and from 2003 till 2007 played for Andorra. He is four-times Andorran Chess Championship winner (2003–2006) and Chess Olympiad individual gold medal winner (2006).
